events.text: What is the capital of France, and what is it known for?
The capital of France is Paris. It's known for the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and being one of the world's centres of art, fashion, and cuisine.

Topic: the James Webb Space Telescope
• Launched Dec 2021 · • Largest infrared space telescope ever built · • Successor to Hubble · • Orbits the Sun-Earth L2 point

Since its December 2021 launch, the James Webb Space Telescope has redefined how we see the cosmos — peering further into infrared light than any observatory before it, from its perch nearly a million miles away at the Sun–Earth L2 point.
Strengths: vivid opening, accurate facts, strong closing image. Improvement: name one discovery; clarify 'redefined' with a concrete example.
